ivalue_training.description: Does a better learning-gain estimator produce a better DETECTOR? The 16-cell gate matrix (docs/ivalue_gate_result.md) measured how well each estimator ranks realised per-sample learning gain, and found that the three architectural fixes lift every legacy model from chance to ~+0.15 Spearman while nothing beats the stored per-node loss EWMA it already receives (+0.171). That is a statement about the estimator, not about accuracy. This suite asks the question that matters: driven through the i-value traversal, does any of it move test accuracy or AUROC? Every arm is i-value traversal on the full AI-Face graph at exactly 10,000 nodes/epoch for 15 epochs, so the arms differ in the estimator and nothing else. control_comprehensive is the i.i.d. sampler that currently beats i-value outright, and is the number to beat rather than a formality. The candidate pool is left at 0 (neighbours only) so the estimator is the single variable; widening it is a separate question.
